name: Twinadew Window: Inertia
source:
Algernon and Vandra are stuck in an elevator... neither of them are particularly sane, but it seems the world isn't either.

[From [url=https://pengosolvent.itch.io/tw-inertia]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
阿尔吉农和凡德拉被困在电梯里……他们都神志不清，但世界似乎也神志不清。
